entities.name: Lupus nephritis
observations: Active renal lupus disease activity is associated with increased urinary IL-22BP in two direct human studies (PMID:25086075; PMID:28887660).

entities.name: IL-22 binding protein
observations: Urinary IL-22BP positively tracked SLEDAI and renal activity measures in adult SLE and juvenile SLE cohorts; it decreased in adult complete treatment responders (PMID:25086075; PMID:28887660).

entities.name: PMID:25086075
observations: In 112 SLE patients, urinary IL-22BP was higher with active renal disease, positively associated with SLEDAI, SLICC renal activity, and biopsy histologic activity, and decreased after six months in complete responders; abstract reports no correlation coefficients.

entities.name: PMID:28887660
observations: In 51 juvenile SLE patients and 31 controls, urinary IL-22BP was higher in active LN (5.47±1.03) than active JSLE without LN (4.23±0.72) or non-active JSLE/LN (3.50±0.65), with positive correlations to SLEDAI-2K, renal SLEDAI, and SLICC renal activity (P<0.001).
